timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.72 today, down 32 cents from a month ago and up $1.00 from a year ago, according to AAA. Springfield averages $3.53. Fill-ups feel a little lighter.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, November 13, in 6 days. Last call for the bow hunters.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, November 14, in 7 days, and runs through November 24. Orange vests are the new fall fashion.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season opens Wednesday, November 25, in 18 days, and runs through January 15. Bow hunters get a second round.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season opens Friday, November 27, in 20 days, and runs through November 29. Tag-along season for the next generation.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, November 11, in 4 days. A good week to say thank you.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26, in 19 days. Start planning the pie lineup.

timely.label: Black Friday
timely.line: Black Friday is Friday, November 27, in 20 days. Start training for the checkout line.

timely.label: New on Netflix
timely.line: Jessica Chastain stars as a former country music legend searching for her missing niece in Nashville in "Heartland," a Netflix original out Friday, Nov. 13. Friday night movie, sorted.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Hall & Oates started a two-week run at No. 1 with "Private Eyes" in 1981, 45 years ago. Clap, clap, clap, clap your hands.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Led Zeppelin released their fourth album, with "Stairway to Heaven," in 1971, 55 years ago. Still the song every guitar store bans.

timely.label: Disney Anniversary
timely.line: Disney's animated "Robin Hood," with Little John and Maid Marian as animal characters, premiered in 1973, 53 years ago. Foxes in tights, a family favorite.

timely.label: TV Anniversary
timely.line: "Gone with the Wind" made its network TV debut on NBC in 1976 and became the highest-rated single broadcast at that time. Frankly, we still give a darn.

timely.label: Pop Culture Anniversary
timely.line: The Pillsbury Dough Boy debuted in TV commercials in 1965. Still giggling after 61 years.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Rolling Stone published its first issue in 1967 with John Lennon on the cover, 59 years ago. Rock news got its home.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is asking hunters in northwest Missouri to have their deer sampled for chronic wasting disease all season. Quick stop, big help.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Virginia hunter Nick Dean hiked 2.5 miles up a rugged public-land mountain to chase the same massive buck for four years. Patience pays, eventually.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Flu season is starting early, with wastewater data showing the earliest onset in at least four years, driven by a mutated H1N1 strain. Stock the tissues now.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: The priciest cars to insure cost up to $4,445 more a year than the cheapest. Check the quote before the test drive.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: New York's new AI law bars chatbots from pretending to be a person or acting dangerously with minors. Parents everywhere are watching.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A company called Enough Phone is making a mini phone for people who want a smaller screen since Apple won't. Small phones, big comeback.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad of 12-year-old triplets requires 20 minutes of reading and a quick summary before they can use their iPad or Switch. Screens wait for the chapter.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster says an air fryer they nearly wrote off now gets used most evenings after barely being touched for months. Sometimes it's worth a second try.
